acceptance.given: An isolated unsupported-package fixture is evaluated with target path, traversal state, policy inputs, and all non-package-support inputs held constant.

oracle.expected: Validation rejects the unsupported package, emits no replay or evaluation result, and records a concrete independent witness tied to that isolated fixture.
forbidden: The fixture changes inputs other than package support status
A result artifact is emitted for the rejected package
Independent witness status is claimed without a fixture-backed observation
oracle.observable: The package-validation test receipt and captured output identify the isolated unsupported-package fixture, show rejection, show result absence, and include an independent witness record.

acceptance.then: The obligation passes only when rejection, result absence, fixture isolation, and independent witness evidence are all observed in the same validation invocation.
acceptance.when: Run the unsupported-package validation selector against the isolated fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the isolated unsupported-package fixture and fail if validation returns success.
Select the unsupported-package result assertion and fail if any replay or evaluation result is produced after rejection.
Select the fixture-backed witness assertion and fail if fixture identity is absent or the witness is copied from another case.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Verify unsupported-package rejection through an isolated fixture while preserving all other inputs, with no result emission and an independently recorded witness.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing skill-package validation receipt schema, capability checks, and fail-closed behavior for all other package cases.

slice_hint.state_transition: unsupported-package fixture submitted -> deterministic rejection -> no result plus independent witness evidence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validation receipt records unsupported-package rejection, absent result, unchanged non-support inputs, and an independent fixture witness.
